newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was moderate late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady to mostly $1.00 lower.

Inquiry was moderate, demand was light. Sales confirmed on 7,500 slaughter steers and 10,600 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 87,700 head confirmed including 16,500 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 67.00, one pen early 68.00; few select with end choice 67.00; few mixed select and choice 1325 lbs Holsteins 61.00.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1000-1075 lbs 67.00; load
